GRADE 8 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — TERM 3 EXAM

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Time: 64 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Reading 7.2.1 Reading for information in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. answer questions from texts for information,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 7.2.1 Reading for information completely.
   C. Reading 7.2.1 Reading for information is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 7.2.1 Reading for information.

2. About Reading 7.2.1 Reading for information when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. create a personal collection of vocabulary related to the theme for comprehension,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 7.2.1 Reading for information completely.
   C. Reading 7.2.1 Reading for information is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 7.2.1 Reading for information.

3. About Reading 7.2.1 Reading for information while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. summarise the key ideas from texts for information,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 7.2.1 Reading for information completely.
   C. Reading 7.2.1 Reading for information is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 7.2.1 Reading for information.

5. About Writing 7.3.1 Essay writing – Descriptive composition in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. identify descriptive words from a text on sports and games,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 7.3.1 Essay writing – Descriptive composition completely.
   C. Writing 7.3.1 Essay writing – Descriptive composition is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 7.3.1 Essay writing – Descriptive composition.

6. About Writing 7.3.1 Essay writing – Descriptive composition when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. write a descriptive composition on a topic related to the theme for information,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 7.3.1 Essay writing – Descriptive composition completely.
   C. Writing 7.3.1 Essay writing – Descriptive composition is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 7.3.1 Essay writing – Descriptive composition.

7. About Writing 7.3.1 Essay writing – Descriptive composition while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. identify descriptive words from a text on sports and games,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 7.3.1 Essay writing – Descriptive composition completely.
   C. Writing 7.3.1 Essay writing – Descriptive composition is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 7.3.1 Essay writing – Descriptive composition.

9. About Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Story telling – Ogre narrative in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. identify gender roles from aural texts for information,
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Story telling – Ogre narrative completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Story telling – Ogre narrative is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Story telling – Ogre narrative.

10. About Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Story telling – Ogre narrative when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. respond to questions on gender roles in the community from texts for comprehension,
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Story telling – Ogre narrative completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Story telling – Ogre narrative is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Story telling – Ogre narrative.

11. About Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Story telling – Ogre narrative while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. identify gender roles from aural texts for information,
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Story telling – Ogre narrative completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Story telling – Ogre narrative is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Story telling – Ogre narrative.

13. About Story telling – Ogre narrative in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Story telling – Ogre narrative using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Story telling – Ogre narrative completely.
   C. Story telling – Ogre narrative is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Story telling – Ogre narrative.

14. About Story telling – Ogre narrative when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Story telling – Ogre narrative at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Story telling – Ogre narrative completely.
   C. Story telling – Ogre narrative is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Story telling – Ogre narrative.

15. About Story telling – Ogre narrative while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?

   B. Learners should ignore Story telling – Ogre narrative completely.
   C. Story telling – Ogre narrative is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Story telling – Ogre narrative.

   D. There is no need to practise Reading 8.2.1 Intensive reading – Ogre stories.

   C. Writing 8.3.1 Creative writing - Songs is only useful outside Kenya.

   C. Writing 8.3.1 Creative writing - Songs is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 8.3.1 Creative writing - Songs.

   C. Writing 8.3.1 Creative writing - Songs is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 8.3.1 Creative writing - Songs.

   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Presentation skills – Songs.

   C. Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Presentation skills – Songs is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Presentation skills – Songs.

29. About Reading 9.2.1 Reading for information in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. identify vocabulary used in texts for information,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 9.2.1 Reading for information completely.
   C. Reading 9.2.1 Reading for information is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 9.2.1 Reading for information.

30. About Reading 9.2.1 Reading for information when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. respond to texts on inter-ethnic cohesion for comprehension,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 9.2.1 Reading for information completely.
   C. Reading 9.2.1 Reading for information is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 9.2.1 Reading for information.

31. About Reading 9.2.1 Reading for information while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. identify vocabulary used in texts for information,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 9.2.1 Reading for information completely.
